title: Point-to-Point ICP
hints: Loop: transform src by the CURRENT estimate T → find each point's nearest target (brute force is fine here) → drop pairs farther than max_corr_dist → Kabsch on the pairs → T = ΔT * T.
Kabsch: centre both sets, H = Σ p̃ q̃ᵀ, SVD, R = V diag(1,1,det(VUᵀ)) Uᵀ, t = q̄ − R p̄.
Compare squared distances in the NN loop and gate with `d2 <= max_corr_dist * max_corr_dist` (inf*inf is still inf).
Stop early when ΔT is tiny (rotation angle and translation < ~1e-10), or when fewer than 3 pairs survive. Return `init` if src or tgt is empty or max_iters == 0.
